Nina Chen: Hey team — quick coordination for the candidate visiting next Tue. Need someone to be the on-site host and confirm laptop/desk setup. Candidate arrival 09:15 PT.
Omar Vasquez: I can host morning session until 12:30. Will meet at lobby at 09:10. :wave:
Kelly R.: FYI they asked for a MacBook or USB-C charger — do we have a loaner free that day?
Ava (People Ops): I'll check loaner inventory. If none, we can request one from IT. Any dietary restrictions for lunch?
Nina Chen: Candidate noted vegetarian and gluten-free. Also needs a quiet room for a 30-min take-home coding task at 10:45.
IT-Ops Bot: Loaner availability lookup: 
```
loaners.get_available(device_type="macbook", date="2024-06-11 to 2024-06-13") => [LOANER-2024-17 (MacBook Pro M1), LOANER-2024-22 (MacBook Air)]
```
Ava (People Ops): Good news — LOANER-2024-17 is free. I'll reserve it under candidate name and create a checkout tag.
Omar Vasquez: Can someone drop a parking pass at reception? Candidate will drive.
Kelly R.: Parking pass booked (Lot B) and added to calendar invite notes. Also reserved Focus Room B for quiet task.
Nina Chen: Door code for visitor badge pickup: please tell them to check in with reception and say "Omar Vasquez candidate". Reception will have a temporary badge and parking pass.
Ava (People Ops): Calendar invite updated with arrival instructions + parking + transit info. Also attached ID checklist. Sent candidate a pre-visit email with a short agenda and directions. :white_check_mark:
Kelly R.: One more — they need VPN access for a short remote repo pull during interview. Can IT pre-create temporary account?
IT-Ops Bot: Creating temporary VPN creds (expiring 6 hours after issue). Please DM candidate email to request.
Nina Chen: Candidate email is emma.lopez@example.com — Ava can you DM IT to issue creds and add instructions (OpenVPN + README)?
Ava (People Ops): On it. I'll DM IT and update the candidate with OpenVPN installer link + README snippet.
Omar Vasquez: Thanks everyone. I'll meet them at the lobby and walk them to Focus Room B. If anything pops up ping me. :thumbsup:
Nina Chen: Awesome — I'll follow up tomorrow with final check.
Ava (People Ops): Checklist done: loaner reserved, parking pass, quiet room, dietary noted, VPN pending. I'll post confirmation here when creds are issued.
IT-Ops Bot: VPN creds queued — awaiting approval from IT admin (eta ~20m). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
